question: Where a rule depends on dates or a processing cycle: cases at a month end, quarter end, year end, 28/29 February, and end of day or cut-off (just before and just after), and across time zones if the story mentions them.

name: Record of the decision (audit trail)
question: When the story says a decision or action must be recorded: a case that checks the record itself (who, what, when, why), not only the outcome.
notes: Should there be an audit record of the appeal

name: Stated performance or volume
question: Only when the story states a time or a volume: a case (or a linked non-functional test) that checks it. If the story states none, this is at most an AC gap ("no performance criterion"), never not_covered.

name: Repeat submission
question: When the story says what happens on a repeat: a case submitting the same item twice.

name: Two users at once
question: When the story says what happens: a case with two users changing the same record at once.

name: Notifications
question: A case checking the notification is sent, to whom, and its key content.
notes: Assumes this is handled elsewhere

name: Personal data shown or masked
question: When the story says what personal data is shown or hidden: a case checking who sees which data.

name: Dependent fields and options
question: Where one value changes what another field offers or requires (for example a country decides the list of counties; a field is required only for business customers): a case for each dependency, AND a case that changes the first value after the second was chosen (the second must update or be cleared).

name: Authentication (log-in): who can get in
question: When the story covers logging in: a case with valid credentials AND a case where wrong, expired or locked credentials are refused.
notes: This might be more the mechanisms of the story but only valid members should be able to appeal
